name: CFDB Form Notifier
author: Abhishek Kumar

sections.description:
CFDB Form Notifier is a comprehensive data and lead management plugin for Contact Form 7. It automatically captures form submissions, securely stores uploaded files, offers advanced filtering and search, allows editing lead statuses and internal remarks, exports data to CSV, supports granular role-based permissions, and provides a secure REST API.

Key Features:

  • Secure Storage: All form submissions are stored in a dedicated database table
  • File Upload Handling: Safely organizes uploaded attachments in an access-protected folder
  • Lead Management: Track and update status (New, In Progress, Converted, etc.) and save private follow-up remarks
  • Role-Based Access Control: Granular 3-tier access control (View, Edit / Export, and Settings) customizable across any user role
  • Custom Lead Statuses & Color Themes: Define custom statuses with 7 vibrant, predefined badge styles (Emerald, Amber, Blue, Purple, Rose, Teal, Slate) and live preview
  • Accessible UI & Design System: Modern switches/toggles, unified custom dropdowns, and cohesive input controls built to design system standards
  • CSV Export: Export submissions filtered by form, year, or month with custom headers and hidden field settings
  • Form Customization: Customize display labels, toggle searchability, and hide unneeded fields per form
  • REST API: Access submissions programmatically with API key authentication (Bearer header or dev mode parameter)
  • Responsive Admin UI: Fast, tabbed dashboard with date and status filters with uniform tab bar styling across pages
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cfdb-form-notifier folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Form Submissions to view and manage leads
  4. Go to Form Submissions > Settings to configure field labels, status options, role permissions, or view your API key
sections.faq:
Can I export form submissions to CSV?

Yes! Use the “Export CSV” button on the Form Submissions dashboard to download submissions filtered by form, year, or month.

Can I update lead status or add remarks?

Yes, click “Edit Lead” on any submission entry to update its status and add internal follow-up remarks.

How do I grant other team members access to form leads?

Go to Settings > Access Control (RBAC) to grant data view/management access to roles such as Editor, Author, or the dedicated Form Manager role.
sections.changelog:
2.5.2

  • UI Updates & Settings Polish: Refined the API settings dashboard with cohesive WordPress Dashicons and consistent button styling.
  • Tab Icon Alignment: Fixed vertical alignment between tab icons and text labels across all navigation tabs.
  • Access Control Presentation: Cleaned role names by removing redundant slug brackets.
  • Card-Based Mobile Views: Reorganized Access Control and Field Customization settings into clean, mobile-optimized cards on viewports under 782px.
  • Copy Button Alignment: Fixed button centering and icon vertical alignment within API endpoint code blocks.

2.5.1

  • Mobile Responsiveness: Added fluid responsive horizontal scroll wrappers for all setting tables (Field Visibility and Role Access Control).
  • Responsive Lead Status Builder: Reorganized custom status rows on small viewports with card stacking and full-width color pickers.
  • Responsive API Dashboard: Fixed API key input/button overflow and adjusted endpoint code block copy button positioning for mobile screens.
  • Filter Bar Mobile UX: Full-width input stacking for submissions filter and search bar on mobile screens (< 782px).

2.5.0

  • Export Dialog: Fixed dropdown overlapping, established equal-width column flex basis, and added mobile stacking.
  • Custom Lead Status Options & Badges: Implemented 7 predefined color themes, real-time preview updating on typing and style changes, and dynamic badge updates.
  • 3-Tier RBAC: Configured View, Edit/Export, and Settings access controls and conditional UI display.
  • Settings Form Picker & Toggles: Replaced native form select with the custom dropdown component, and converted all checkboxes to modern toggles.
  • Searchable Field Logic: Fixed regex matching for search queries against configured keys in serialized form data.
  • Uniform Tab Navigation: Unified the Submissions page and Settings page tab bars into identical design token structures.
  • Universal Input Styling: Styled all text inputs, textareas, selects, and modals to match the Impeccable design system tokens.

2.0.0

  • UI Overhaul: Modern, compact card-based interface for submissions.
  • Improved form navigation tabs.

1.0.2

  • Enhanced API authentication with Bearer header support.
  • Fixed: Removed custom headers to comply with WordPress REST API standards

1.0.1

  • Improved: Exclude Google reCAPTCHA responses from database storage
  • Fixed: Automatic cleanup of existing reCAPTCHA data during plugin update
  • Fixed: Form submission time now displays in WordPress site timezone instead of GMT

1.0.0

  • Initial release
